tools_used: courtlistener MCP (search, call_endpoint dockets, docket-entries, get_endpoint_item)
helpful: Full-text petition and brief in opposition under record/documents; the BIO's account of the companion denials was decisive.
The sal-v4 per-Term band table with bracketed reached rates, matching the frozen band.
gaps: CourtListener's search index returns nothing for SCOTUS docket_number filters, and the dockets endpoint leaves date_terminated null for decided SCOTUS petitions, so companion-case status could not be confirmed from it; a provisioned 'companion petitions' cut (same QP, same lower court, this Term) with their dispositions would have been the most useful input.
The reply brief is on the docket but not provisioned.
fedcourts query has no originating-court or text filter, so CAAF-specific priors could not be pulled.
notes: Nine retrieval calls in total, well under the advisory budget. The corpus query's ranked rows were mostly OT2025 applications and pending grants, not comparable cert priors; for a cert cell the statpack tables carried the base-rate weight.
